en.headline: Free Asian Ethnic Cultural Performances carnival opens at Cultural Centre today
en.dek: Performers from around 30 countries gather at the Tsim Sha Tsui piazza from 2pm to 6pm under the theme Blessings in Full Bloom.
body: A free outdoor carnival of dance, music and crafts from about 30 countries and regions opens today at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre in Tsim Sha Tsui.

The Leisure and Cultural Services Department said the Asian Ethnic Cultural Performances+ 2026 event runs from 2pm to 6pm on the piazza and foyer. It forms the finale of the Asia+ Festival 2026 and is themed Blessings in Full Bloom.

The organisers said performers will present traditional rituals, dance and music. An accompanying exhibition, Convergence of Cross-Cultural Gifting, continues in the foyer until 29 November. Admission is free.

The Culture, Sports and Tourism Bureau presented the programme, which is organised by the Leisure and Cultural Services Department. Visitors are advised to check the event page for any last-minute programme changes.

zh.headline: 亞洲民族文化表演嘉年華今日尖沙咀文化中心免費舉行
zh.dek: 約30個國家及地區表演者下午二時至六時在廣場演出，主題為「福滿綻放」。
body: 一場免費的戶外嘉年華今日於尖沙咀香港文化中心舉行，約30個國家及地區的舞蹈、音樂及工藝表演匯聚一堂。
康樂及文化事務署表示，亞洲民族文化表演+ 2026由下午二時至六時在廣場及大堂進行，是2026亞藝無疆的壓軸活動，主題為「福滿綻放」。
主辦方稱，表演者將呈現傳統儀式、舞蹈及音樂。相關展覽「跨文化贈禮的匯聚」將於大堂展出至11月29日。入場免費。
活動由文化體育及旅遊局呈獻，康文署主辦。市民可留意活動網頁，以獲取最新節目安排。
